data class A(
    val b: B? = null
) {
    fun toJson(): Map<String, Any?> {
        val map = mutableMapOf<String, Any?>()
        map["b"] = b?.toJson()
        return map
    }

    companion object {
        fun fromJson(json: Map<String, Any?>): A {
            return A(
                b = (json["b"] as? Map<String, Any?>)?.let { B.fromJson(it) }
            )
        }
    }
}

data class B(
    val a: A? = null
) {
    fun toJson(): Map<String, Any?> {
        val map = mutableMapOf<String, Any?>()
        map["a"] = a?.toJson()
        return map
    }

    companion object {
        fun fromJson(json: Map<String, Any?>): B {
            return B(
                a = (json["a"] as? Map<String, Any?>)?.let { A.fromJson(it) }
            )
        }
    }
}

data class TreeNode(
    val children: List<TreeNode>? = null,
    val value: String
) {
    fun toJson(): Map<String, Any?> {
        val map = mutableMapOf<String, Any?>()
        map["children"] = children?.map { it.toJson() }
        map["value"] = value
        return map
    }

    companion object {
        fun fromJson(json: Map<String, Any?>): TreeNode {
            return TreeNode(
                children = (json["children"] as? List<*>)?.map { TreeNode.fromJson(it as Map<String, Any?>) },
                value = json["value"] as String
            )
        }
    }
}
